notes:
Account background: ClariWell is a mid-size healthtech provider (EHR add-on) building a federated clinical search + RAG layer for provider workflows. Primary goals: fast, precise retrieval from a large clinical document corpus (approx 15–25M docs), strict PHI controls, and predictable cost per query.

Key requirements / constraints: 
- Index scale: target ~20M documents (notes, imaging reports, discharge summaries). Expect 5–10B tokens total; nightly refresh window for new notes.
- Embeddings: want high-dim clinical-tuned vectors; initial plan to embed via batch jobs in private environment. Interested in Redwood recommendations for quantized open models vs hosted embeddings.
- Reranking: must run reranker at top-100 candidates; p95 rerank latency budget <= 250–350ms (end-to-end search+rerank).
additional_notes:
Security/compliance specifics (paraphrased from security call): 
- Full PHI scope: patient identifiers in notes; cannot send PHI to public endpoints. Need VPC-only private control plane and/or on-prem agent.
- Audit requirements: per-user per-request logging, immutable audit trail w/ daily export to their SIEM (Splunk).
- Key management: customer-managed KMS + HSM preferred for model keys and data encryption.
- Identity: SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, RBAC and fine-grained entitlements for index-level access.

POC plan (agreed):
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): small-scale index (100k docs) in dedicated VPC; measure embedding throughput and per-query cost estimate.
- Phase 2 (3 weeks): scale to 2M docs, validate reranker latency at 99th pct, test cache/kv prefixing to reduce token costs.
- Phase 3 (4 weeks): full-scale ingestion plan + runbook for nightly refresh; security review sign-off.

Quotes / notes from stakeholders: 
- "We cannot allow any PHI to leave our VPC during POC" — Head of Infra (Marcus Lee).
- "Need clear cost math: cost per query including embedding refresh amortization" — Product lead (Julia Park).

Tech considerations discussed: 
- Prefer open-weight quantized models for embeddings to avoid outbound model calls; but open to Redwood-hosted private instances if keys/KMS are customer-managed.
- Reranker candidates: plan to test small cross-encoder reranker running on dedicated GPUs vs sequence-level lightweight reranker for cost tradeoff.
- Caching strategy: prefix KV caching for common templates (discharge notes) to cut token costs on repeated queries.

Open questions for Redwood: 
- Example audit log schema for per-token/per-request logging (format for SIEM).
- Recommended hardware sizing for 20M-doc index with nightly refresh and top-100 rerank SLAs.
- Sample cost model for 1k QPS mixed workload (50% search, 30% rerank, 20% embeddings refresh amortized).

- SE to provide sample audit logs and recommended SIEM field mapping.
